kind: Author static self-review before fresh runtime acceptance

findings.finding: Both pay/cancel methods explicitly declare READ_COMMITTED; first statement in each protected write branch is CustomerWriteGuard.lock(actor).
Owned order lookup binds user_id and exact case-insensitive order_no, with FOR UPDATE; malformed/unknown/foreign resources are 404.
result is bound after owned-order lock using InputChecks enum and rejects missing/duplicate/invalid values with 400.
Pending FAILURE returns before any mapper write; all payment branches omit product and item mapper calls.
Pending SUCCESS conditionally writes only paid status, MOCK receipt, first UTC microsecond timestamp; generation is 39 safe characters and DB unique key handles collisions.
PAID/SHIPPED/COMPLETED SUCCESS replays return without DML; FAILURE and cancelled payment are conflicts.
CANCELLED replay returns before item/product lookups; paid and subsequent states reject cancellation.
Pending cancellation sorts immutable lines by productId, locks all products before validating or writing.
INT stock addition uses long precheck; BIGINT version cap checked; SQL repeats stock/version overflow guards and version predicate.
Restock changes stock/version only and checks every affected row; cancellation timestamp and state update occur in same Service transaction.
No new SQL updates cart_item, sales_order_item, receiver, total_amount or other order snapshot fields.
Payment/cancellation timestamps are SQL GREATEST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),created_at), respecting UTC datasource and CHECK lower bound.
Controller uses fixed 303 RedirectView and fixed flash text; unknown/foreign errors use shared handler, owned conflicts use safe recovery page.
All five candidate Java paths are newly added payment package files; existing STEP09 Java sources untouched.
DataIntegrityViolation/ConcurrencyFailure convert to safe runtime BusinessException, with no internal cause/raw input logging and no automatic writer retry.

private_compile.scope: Private compile only, not wrapper or runtime verification

limitations: No real HTTP, database state transition, rollback, browser screenshot or race result is asserted by this review.
Fault injection and payment/cancel concurrency are deliberately STEP13.
Private javac does not substitute for actual Wrapper builds or fresh private MySQL acceptance.
